summary: Describes the Access Node Control Protocol, which runs between a Network Access Server and an access node such as a DSLAM in a broadband network. It supports operations related to quality of service, services, and subscribers, and includes capabilities beyond the base protocol.

eli5.summary: Broadband equipment close to your home needs instructions from a central machine. ANCP is the language they use, like a manager radioing a worker at a street cabinet to adjust things.

questions: how does a nas control a dslam
